{{Color box|{{party color|Kambilan}}|border=darkgray}} [[Kambilan|KAMBILAN]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Pampanga's 4th Congressional District''' is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Pampanga]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It consists of municipalities in southern and eastern Pampanga, namely: [[Apalit]], [[Candaba]], [[Macabebe]], [[Masantol]], [[Minalin]], [[San Luis, Pampanga|San Luis]], [[San Simon, Pampanga|San Simon]] and [[Santo Tomas, Pampanga|Santo Tomas]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Anna York Bondoc]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] and [[Kambilan]]. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
